fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 6.0% of Gross Revenue, due by 3rd day of month for preceding month; franchisee may be eligible for a 0.5% Royalty Fee Credit if certain LOS and compliance requirements are met. System Assessment Fee (marketing/services) is 3.0% of GR. Additional ongoing fees include: Standard Revenue Management Services at 0.75% of GR (min $645, max $1,395/month); Premium Revenue Management Services at 1.00% of GR (min $1,450, max $2,450/month); Loyalty Program Charge at 2.5% of member-earned amounts; Agency Commissions up to 20% of GR; Member Benefits Commissions up to 10% of GR; Agency Commission Service Charge 1.5% of commissionable revenue; Member Benefits Commission Service Charge 1.5% of commissionable revenue; Everyone Sells Group Referrals Program 10% of commissionable revenue. Per-reservation fees: GDS $7.25, Third Party Channel $2.25, Internet Booking $2.25. Per-unit/month fees: MOP $0.60, OPERA Cloud Premium PMS $12.60, Wyndham WIFI HCS $0.85. Fixed monthly/annual fees include PMS Monthly Support $699-$1,000/month, STR Report $750/year, Continuing Education $1,200/year, ESD $35/month. Various one-time or event-driven fees also apply (training, QA inspections, etc.). Tech fees are unit-count based rather than a single flat monthly figure.
